messages:
thomas: Opening a short action thread for the partial-response + timeout pattern we saw yesterday (02:10 UTC). Symptoms: clients reported truncated streaming, then rapid reconnects causing rate spikes.
eli: I pushed the draft postmortem earlier — TL;DR: intermittent upstream S3 latency + client-side reconnect loop exposed a gap in our client SDK backoff. link: https://redwood.internal/pm/17697-postmortem :eyes:
ops-bot: Deploy notice: rolled back model-serving change at 02:45 UTC; no errors after rollback. Reaction :white_check_mark:.
maria: Key ask — we need durable mitigations (server fallback + client changes) not just rollback. Proposing owners and timelines below.
sam: Agreed. I can own the client SDK backoff change (add exponential backoff with jitter + max retry cap). Quick plan: add 500ms base, 2x multiplier, jitter, cap at 8s, and ensure we stop reattempting on 4xx. Draft PR by EOD.
thomas: Server side: investigate K/V cache eviction and streaming gateway timeouts. I will own a config audit and a canary for 5% traffic with stricter timeouts (10s -> 6s server-side keepalive) to surface regressions. Canary by tomorrow morning.
maria: Ops item: add a circuit-breaker metric and dashboard for streaming partials + reconnect surge. @ops-bot can you create the alert?
ops-bot: Created alert "streaming.partial_responses.rate" threshold 0.3% over 5m -> slack #incidents paging to oncall. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/streaming-partials
eli: Also: add a synthetic test that opens 500 concurrent streaming connections and injects 100ms extra S3 latency to recreate the pattern. I will add that to CI as a nightly job. ETA 72h.
sam: Client SDK change: small snippet for reviewers:
```js
// exponential backoff for streaming reconnects
const base = 500;
let attempt = 0;
function nextDelay() {
  attempt++;
  const jitter = Math.random() * base;
  return Math.min(base * 2 ** attempt + jitter, 8000);
}
```
thomas: Action list (owners + deadlines):
- Client SDK: implement backoff + stop-on-4xx (owner: sam, due: 2026-04-05)
- Server keepalive audit + canary (owner: thomas, canary start: 2026-03-26 09:00 UTC)
- Synthetic test in CI (owner: eli, due: 2026-03-29)
- Dashboard + alert (owner: maria, alert created by ops-bot, verify by 2026-03-25)
- Postmortem follow-up doc with regression test cases and SLA impact calc (owner: eli, due: 2026-03-28)
maria: Let's also capture recurrence pattern: this is the 3rd partial-response cluster in 60 days (2026-01-15, 2026-02-23, 2026-03-24). We should treat it as a recurring class and consider longer-term architectural fixes (streaming gateway resiliency).
sam: Noted — I'll add a GH issue to product/infra backlog: "streaming gateway resiliency: connection pooling & graceful degrade".
eli: Quick checklist for owners: include deployment playbook steps, rollback criteria (error rate down <0.05% and reconnects <0.1% for 15m), and customer communication template.
thomas: I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to review canary results and mark items as done/blocked. Invite: @maria @eli @sam.
maria: Thanks all. I'll verify the alert dashboards and compile updates into the incident follow-up doc after the sync. :lock:
sam: PR reference when ready will be linked here.
eli: Closing note: keep this thread for action updates only — small updates OK, major changes put in the postmortem doc.
thomas: Closing the loop: will post canary results in this thread + update timestamps.
